findings.title: Headless render latency (12405ms) exceeds crawl time budget on /
findings.evidence: Hydration and DOM stabilization took 12405ms (threshold: 4500ms). Real-world AI crawlers (OAI-SearchBot) operate on strict 3-5 second timeouts and drop slow-rendering pages.

suggested_action.summary: Optimize client bundle size, defer non-critical scripts, or implement server-side pre-rendering to keep time-to-content under 3.5 seconds.

missing_snippets_sample: The best-specced product isn't the most expensive in 86% of categories.
Here's what 200 calls actually costs, vendor by vendor.

Phonely's 33–34% annual discount is the biggest published in AI receptionists — most vendors publish none Pay-annually savings range from a third off at Phonely down to nothing at all, and the headline percentage matters less than what it does to the actual monthly number you pay.

Goodcall's 'unlimited minutes' has a meter — and it runs on unique callers, not time Goodcall is the only vendor in this market that bills by how many distinct people call you, so a busy month can quietly double your Starter bill before you notice the cap exists.

findings.title: Schema entity (WebSite ('The Front Desk Review')) lacks description property on /
findings.evidence: The WebSite ('The Front Desk Review') entity has no 'description' field. AI summarizers rely on this field for atomic entity synthesis.
findings.suggested_action: Provide a factual, 1-2 sentence description explaining what the entity is, who uses it, and its core capabilities.

findings.title: Consider adding quantitative metrics to improve AI citation probability
findings.evidence: Page contains 6299 words but 0 explicit numeric statistics or benchmarks.
findings.suggested_action: The Princeton GEO study demonstrated that adding verifiable statistics increases AI citation probability by +37%. Consider integrating benchmark data or concrete metrics.

findings.title: Consider presenting comparative pricing options in a structured table
findings.evidence: Page contains multiple pricing indicators but 0 <table> elements. LLMs quote structured tables at a significantly higher rate than narrative prose.
findings.suggested_action: Structure plan comparisons into an HTML <table> with rows and columns for plan names, prices, and features.

findings.title: Article relies entirely on circular self-citations with zero external reference links
findings.evidence: Page contains 132 links, but 100% of them point back to frontdeskreview.com. Zero external primary sources or research citations are provided.
findings.suggested_action: Integrate outbound citations to authoritative external sources (standards, benchmarks, institutional studies) to establish a verifiable credibility chain for LLMs.
